shared_elements: linear/geometric markings or signs arranged in short bands or rows
justification: The only real shared depicted content is the presence of simple incised linear/geometric marks, with some appearing in row-like bands. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a schematic anthropomorphic figure with body parts and internal motifs, while B is essentially a blank rectangular field bordered by rows of sign-like marks and has no figure or comparable iconographic scene.
